terms.meaning: Links that tell the compiler which projects depend on which.
A compiler command that builds linked projects in the right order.

used_by: The typecheck:libs command in the root package.json.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Library project list
sections.what: Lists the three library folders as projects to build together.
sections.why: Lets one command check all shared libraries.
sections.watch_out: Each listed folder needs its own tsconfig.json, or the build stops.

summary: The root TypeScript settings. It points to three library projects so they can be built together. It checks no code itself.
purpose: Lets the typecheck:libs command build the shared libraries.
why: Likely reason: the root file only coordinates the library projects. The file says files is empty.
how: Extends the base config, sets an empty file list, and lists three project references.
inputs: The three library folders: lib/db, lib/api-client-react, and lib/api-zod.
risks: Adding a library here without its own config breaks the build.
debug: If typecheck:libs fails, check that each listed folder has its own tsconfig.json.
